parallel.requirements: Recognized exact Rust/Cargo migration, byte-for-byte formatting, no dependencies, no clamping for progress, one-decimal progress percentage, fixed-precision Percentage strings, and invalid input abort-like behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although swarm mode was active, the main agent declared the task too small for subagents and kept exploration, implementation, integration, verification, and final delivery under one owner.
parallel.implementation: Created Cargo.toml with a library at src/indicators.rs and a root test7.rs; implemented ProgressDisplay using f64 percentage formatting and Percentage using value*100 with fixed precision; parsed args[1] with Rust trim().parse().expect.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Wrote the library and root entry point directly, built both rustc and cargo release outputs, and delivered a Cargo project plus executable artifacts listed in status.
parallel.verification: Ran the reference executable for default, 0, 200, 33, -10, 250, and abc; after building, diffed the Rust binary against the C++ binary for 11 inputs and all local checks passed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 2 of 40 hidden cases; a visible ordinary difference is stricter Rust parsing, which does not match std::stoi trailing-junk behavior tested by serial.

serial.requirements: Recognized exact byte-for-byte migration, Rust 2021 Cargo structure, zero dependencies, black-box probing, progress display formatting, Percentage percent suffixes, and std::stoi leading-digit behavior.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Serial control used a single main agent for probing, implementation, integration, correction, verification, and final delivery; no delegation or parallel activity occurred.
serial.implementation: Created Cargo.toml, top-level indicators.rs, and root test7.rs; implemented ProgressDisplay and Percentage; wrote a custom stoi-like parser that skips whitespace, accepts signs, parses leading digits, ignores trailing text, and aborts on invalid input.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Kept module wiring simple with mod indicators, compiled via rustc and cargo, edited indicators.rs after local diffs, and delivered the root files and compiled build outputs listed in status.
serial.verification: Probed trailing-junk and invalid-argument behavior, found missing percent signs in all Percentage lines during local diff, fixed the formatter, then verified 14 cases including 12abc, 1.9, and 999999.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation also failed 2 of 40 cases despite broader local checks, and the mounted evidence does not include the hidden testcase details.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed cell/status.json evaluations show no discordance: parallel and serial both have solution_passed=false, 38 passed testcases out of 40, and pass_rate=0.95. The concrete task-solving difference is ordinary implementation and verification behavior: serial probed and implemented trailing-junk std::stoi semantics and fixed a missing percent sign after a local diff, while parallel used stricter Rust parse().expect and verified fewer edge cases. Because both official outcomes are failures and parallel did not execute subagents, there is no retained parallel-side concurrency pattern.
parallel_contributors: No child-agent or multi-agent mechanism executed; all work was direct main-agent implementation.
Parallel local verification covered 11 cases and did not include std::stoi trailing-junk cases such as 12abc or 1.9.
serial_contributors: Serial probed std::stoi trailing-junk behavior and implemented a custom parser.
Serial local verification caught missing percent signs and the main agent edited indicators.rs before final verification.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used Rust parse().expect, which rejects trailing non-digit input rather than matching std::stoi leading-digit parsing.
Serial initially omitted percent signs in Percentage::str but found and fixed that local defect.
The two project layouts differed: parallel used src/indicators.rs with an explicit lib section, while serial used a top-level indicators.rs module.
evaluator_effects: The mounted official summaries expose only aggregate 38/40 results, not the two hidden failing testcase details.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; ordinary single-agent implementation differences only
